about.content: Run Girl Run is an animation studio based in Toronto. We aim to bring unique concepts and ideas to life.
Mostly working in 3D animation, we're always expanding our knowledge to better serve the stories we want to tell. Whether an idea lives better in a different medium altogether, we go for it.
Eventually, the goal is to make original features, built entirely in-house from the ground up.

The studio is led by an animator and generalist with production experience at the National Film Board of Canada. That background informs how we work — with an understanding of pipelines, collaboration, and general creativeness that it comes with.
